index beads_membership_unknown: CREATE INDEX beads_membership_unknown ON beads(id) WHERE membership_known IS NULL
index beads_phase: CREATE INDEX beads_phase ON beads(phase, status)
index edges_target: CREATE INDEX edges_target ON edges(depends_on_id, type)
index journal_applied_epoch: CREATE INDEX journal_applied_epoch ON journal(applied_epoch) WHERE state = 'applied'
index journal_applied_unknown: CREATE INDEX journal_applied_unknown ON journal(seq) WHERE state = 'applied' AND applied_epoch IS NULL
index journal_pending: CREATE INDEX journal_pending ON journal(state, bead, seq)
index scope_member_bead: CREATE INDEX scope_member_bead ON scope_member(bead)
table beads: CREATE TABLE beads ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, phase TEXT, status TEXT, updated_at TEXT, row_json TEXT NOT NULL, synced_at TEXT NOT NULL, stale INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, membership_known INTEGER, revision TEXT)
table edges: CREATE TABLE edges ( issue_id TEXT NOT NULL, depends_on_id TEXT NOT NULL, type TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (issue_id, depends_on_id, type))
table hook_state: CREATE TABLE hook_state ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1), consecutive_failures INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, first_failure_at TEXT, last_error TEXT, next_attempt_at TEXT)
table journal: CREATE TABLE journal ( seq INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, idem_key TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, phase TEXT, bead TEXT NOT NULL, op TEXT NOT NULL, args_json TEXT NOT NULL, precondition_json TEXT NOT NULL, actor TEXT NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (state IN ('pending','applied','escalated','resolved')), attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, last_error TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, announced_at TEXT, applied_at TEXT, applied_epoch INTEGER, last_error_code TEXT, note TEXT, changed INTEGER, first_offered_at TEXT)
table meta: CREATE TABLE meta (key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL)
table ready_base: CREATE TABLE ready_base ( scope TEXT PRIMARY KEY, blocked_json TEXT NOT NULL, ready_json TEXT NOT NULL, fetched_at TEXT NOT NULL, stale INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, indexed INTEGER)
table ready_base_blocked: CREATE TABLE ready_base_blocked ( scope TEXT NOT NULL, bead TEXT NOT NULL, blocked_by_json TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (scope, bead)) WITHOUT ROWID
table sc_cron_schedule: CREATE TABLE sc_cron_schedule ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, generation INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (generation BETWEEN 1 AND 4294967295), name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (length(CAST(name AS BLOB)) BETWEEN 1 AND 128), expr TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(CAST(expr AS BLOB)) <= 256), timeout_ms INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (timeout_ms > 0), jitter_ms INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (jitter_ms >= 0), payload TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(CAST(payload AS BLOB)) <= 65536), created_at TEXT NOT NULL, next_run_at TEXT, last_run_at TEXT, last_outcome TEXT, ended_at TEXT, stop_reason TEXT, enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (enabled IN (0, 1)), CHECK ((ended_at IS NULL) = (next_run_at IS NOT NULL)), CHECK ((ended_at IS NULL) = (stop_reason IS NULL)) )
table scope: CREATE TABLE scope ( name TEXT PRIMARY KEY, kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'phase', revision TEXT, filter TEXT)
table scope_member: CREATE TABLE scope_member ( scope TEXT NOT NULL, bead TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (scope, bead))
table sync_state: CREATE TABLE sync_state ( phase TEXT PRIMARY KEY, last_started_at TEXT, last_ok_at TEXT, last_error TEXT, backend_kind TEXT, endpoint TEXT, replica_id TEXT, journal_seq INTEGER, failing_since TEXT, notified_since TEXT)
table tick_lease: CREATE TABLE tick_lease ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1), run_id TEXT, pid INTEGER, host TEXT, expires_at TEXT)
meta sc_cron_schedule_version: 2
pragma user_version: 3
